notes.title: Jump Kid Demo Update 0.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40382046/21b22f6560ee335c962092444da7651fa5f8dabc.png[/img]

Jump Kid Demo version 0.1 is live! Thank to player support I was able to fix and configure some key elements to the gameplay of Jump Kid.

Special thanks to these players for testing the demo and helping add some key features and bug fixes:

RuneShow
Itolman4
The Ghost
Gianbear
Sange
The Doctor

If you'd like to be featured in the next announcement, be sure to download the demo and either leave a post anywhere on social media or steam, or better yet fill out the survey! [url=https://forms.gle/qVkaFYEeuU3P25Jj7]LINK HERE[/url]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[b]Fixed a zone that should have killed the player in 1-1 Jumpy Jungle
Fixed default resolution being set to 800x600 on startup
Fixed the player being able to go out of bounds at the first portal in 1-1 Jumpy Jungle
Fixed the players hat being on a ghost in the portal on 1-1 Jumpy Jungle
[/b]

[h3]Updates[/h3]

[b]Jump Meter[/b]
Due to player suggestions, I have added a Jump Meter to the right hand side of the screen that lets the player know how much power they are using in their jumps. This will help both new and returning players better judge how they will tackle certain jumps. It will also further explain how long you can hold the jump button until it hits its maximum. 

[b]Updated Tutorial[/b]
Not only is there a new tutorial segment explaining the Jump Meter, also due to player feedback some other key features weren't really explained either. I have now updated the tutorial to explain all main mechanics and key bindings needed to play Jump Kid. 

[b]Faster Deaths[/b]
3 seconds seemed like a long time to wait before you respawn. Which I totally agree! Players vented their frustration on how long it took to respawn, so I have made a huge change to the respawn speed. Dying has been shortened dramatically, which will allow you to die even faster now.

[b]Updated Trees[/b]
It was really frustrating to repeatedly die in the beginning of a checkpoint, so I have made some adjustments to the tree segment in 1-1 Jumpy Jungle. 

Update may require you to replay the tutorial. 

Thank you to everyone who has play tested Jump Kid thus far, and I look forward to updating the game even more. All feedback is always welcome and I appreciate everyone's input more than anything.

notes.title: NEW JumpKid Demo Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40382046/63be07c4f53fa44d7bd368f463ba58d065167672.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=kg7g5301rKU;full][/previewyoutube]

It has been a while since I gave you fellas an update on JumpKid, so hopefully this announcement is exciting for some of you. But before I go into the details of the new demo remember everything about the game is liable to change. I HIGHLY recommend you join the discord if you wish to help me make JumpKid the best game it can be.

As promised, the completely newly remade JumpKid demo is coming very, VERY soon. I don't like to promise exact dates, but don't be surprised if it comes out within a week or two from now. In the demo you will be able to experience many new mechanics the old version did not have. To name just a few:

1. First look into the in-game challenge system.
2. Never seen before had shop to make your character look especially dumb. 
3. A fun and creatively new visual experience. (Seriously the game looks way nicer now)
4. Test the new playable characters.
5. Newly implemented tutorial.
6. And of course last but not least, the honor of being the first ones to play the first level of the base game once JumpKid fully released. (Content liable to change drastically)

Once the demo is out and ready for you to play, I will post much more in depth detail about what you can and can't do for those who don't like reading too much. But one thing you can know for sure is I genuinely believe you will find the game not only challenging, but most importantly fun. 

I will most likely be posting it to my itch.io page when it's ready. Maybe there is a way I can make a demo on Steam, but until then be sure to follow my social media so you know exactly when and where to download it! 

[url=https://divinal.itch.io/]Itchio[/url]

Huge shoutout to those who are interested in the project so far. Can't thank you all enough. Join the discord, follow the social media, but more than anything have a fabulous day!
